gem_guidance.text: As the actual BiS is fairly straightforward, the only thing that's really arguable is how to gem it. Although there are many different ways to gem in Phase 5, opting for a +healing setup and downranking properly (CoH 4, Renew 10, FH8) will likely be the way to go for most players in Sunwell Plateau , as it provides more sustain than spirit-heavy gemming when used correctly and also allows for upranking when needed to match the throughput of haste-heavy gemming. However, if you're certain mana is absolutely not an issue, you can choose to primarily gem Quick Lionseye while activating your metagem through two purple gems.
